rules: recovered qosa-1.0.0 3x9; global-ever-open and current-only side-local model both provisional
selectedSeedSetMethod: Deterministic: first 200 seeds in ascending order that yield a latest eligible state; at most one position per seed. Reproduce from this window and the runner selection rule.
openingFollowupSelector: canonical tile; unsigned seed modulo four sides
selection: latest state per seed with >=2 legal actions, both opponents <=3 tiles, prior no-stock pass by a hidden seat
posterior: Exact labeled allocations; pass-time hand = current hidden hand + same-seat tiles played after pass; no-intervening-draw passes only; no opponent-choice likelihood.
currentOnlyDefinition: A number opened by a double is usable only on side(s) active and ending in that number when the double was played; later arrivals on other sides are locked. Provisional counterfactual.
nextAction: Collect current-only-compatible or real public traces; rerun matched candidate comparisons only on joint hidden-world support, keeping model-divergent traces separate.
